description: Source code for KeysManagementClient class handling API key management via HTTP requests, including listing, generating, deleting, updating, and retrieving info about API keys.

classes.name: KeysManagementClient
classes.description: Client class for managing API keys through HTTP API calls, supporting operations like list, generate, delete, update, and info.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the client with base URL and optional API key.

methods.name: _get_headers
methods.description: Prepares headers for API requests, including authorization if API key is set.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists API keys with optional filters and pagination.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a new API key with specified parameters.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes specified API keys or key aliases.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates parameters of an existing API key.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific API key.
